name: image-converter-plugin-deps
description: Vendored runtime dependencies for the image-converter plugin's codec support — see tools/convert-image.js. Committed node_modules, not gitignored: the plugin installer copies this directory verbatim with no npm-install step, so the resolved dependency tree must already exist on disk for Node's module resolution to find it (same pattern as plugins/data-analyzer/package.json). png/jpg/webp are WASM codecs (@jsquash/*, repackaged Squoosh); gif/bmp are pure JS (no equivalent WASM package exists on npm — confirmed 2026-08-25).
